title: Little Leaps content pack
description: Shared metadata and screen container for all content packs. Schema validity does not establish child-safety or compliance approval.

ageBand.description: Target age band, such as 7-9. New age bands do not require a schema change.

type.description: Activity type understood by the engine, such as story-choice or matching. Not an exhaustive list.

version.description: Content revision, incremented whenever the pack changes.

reviewStatus.description: Approved requires actual child-safety/compliance review of this content revision, not internal approval or schema validation.

screens.description: Static screen data. Individual activity types define their screen fields; an empty array is allowed for unfinished packs.
